title: RBX Agent Session
description: An isolated execution context for one session type within a mission. Sessions do not share raw context — only what is explicitly passed through declared outputs. Each session type carries specific context constraints to prevent noise contamination.

mission_id.description: Parent mission this session belongs to.

session_type.description: Session type determines what context is appropriate and what must be excluded. Each type has specific carries/must-not-carry constraints documented in MISSION-EXECUTION-GRAPH.md.

agent_id.description: Agent operating in this session. Must match the agent's domain contract for the session_type.

orchestrator_id.description: agent_id of the Mission Orchestrator that created this session, if applicable.

context_budget_policy_id.description: ID of the ContextBudgetPolicy that governs token allocation in this session.

allowed_tools.description: Tools available in this session. Must be a subset of the agent's domain contract allowed_tools.

memory_scopes.description: Memory scopes accessible in this session. Must be a subset of the agent's domain contract allowed_memory_scopes.

output_type.description: Expected output type (e.g., code_diff, test_results, summary, architecture_proposal).

required.description: If true, session is not considered complete without this output.

output_ref.description: Reference to the produced output once available.

expected_outputs.description: Outputs this session must produce. Used for session completion evaluation.

retain_outputs.description: If true, session outputs are retained for use by subsequent sessions.

raw_history_ttl_hours.description: How long to retain raw conversation history in hours. Null means retain indefinitely. 0 means discard after session closes.

summarize_on_close.description: If true, a summarization step is automatically appended before the session closes, compressing history into a memory item.

parent_session_id.description: Session ID of the parent session, if this session was spawned from another (e.g., a coding session spawned from a planning session).

expires_at.description: Optional session expiry. Expired sessions emit session.expired and are closed.

context_items_loaded.description: IDs of context items (files, memory items, step outputs) loaded into this session. Tracked for audit and context budget accounting.
